spans.text: Now stand still and don't move. I'll clean you up.

units.rawText: It's one thing to not wear makeup, but if you're going around barefaced, then you need to take care of it too.

units.rawText: Especially in a place where people come and go like an airport—you need to pay attention to hygiene! You can't be careless just because you just woke up.

units.rawText: ...Thank you, although I think most Dolls don't need stuff that's so extreme.

units.rawText: I've been meaning to ask, but why do you look so lifeless? You fell asleep shortly after getting on the plane. Are you not used to long journeys?

units.rawText: Maybe it's because I haven't rested properly over the past few days. Whenever I thought about how I'd be coming back here, my heart filled up with conflicting emotions...

spans.text: ...Millau, I'm really impressed by how you can describe things in a way that seem almost the same but are different in subtle yet important ways.

units.rawText: If I had to describe it with a local saying, then I suppose it would be "feeling uneasy as you approach your home."

units.rawText: Hmm? Is that how it is? Well, that doesn't matter.

units.rawText: As an ace reporter... As a former ace reporter who's been there and done that, you can take it to heart.
